thread.title: Taiwan Semiconductor Sees Strong 2018 Sales From Cryptocurrency Mining Boom

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Taiwan Semiconductor Sees Strong 2018 Sales From Cryptocurrency Mining Boom

organizations.name: cryptocurrency mining boom taiwan semiconductor manufacturing co.

text:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. ( TSM ), commonly known as TSMC, on Thursday forecast record sales in 2018 thanks to the ongoing boom in cryptocurrency mining and trading. But its soft outlook for mobile phone chip sales raised questions about major customer Apple ( AAPL ) and demand for its latest iPhones.
X TSMC, the main chip supplier for Apple iPhones and iPads, earned 64 cents per U.S. share in the fourth quarter, up 7% year over year, on sales of $9.21 billion, up 12%. Analysts expected 62 cents and $9.15 billion, according to Zacks Investment Research.
"Our fourth quarter business was supported by major mobile product launches and continuing demand for cryptocurrency mining," TSMC Chief Financial Officer Lora Ho said in a news release . "Moving into first quarter 2018, we expect the strong demand for cryptocurrency mining will continue while mobile product seasonality will dampen our business in this quarter."
TSMC forecast first quarter sales of $8.45 billion, based on the midpoint of its guidance, topping projections for $8.24 billion. It did not give a target for earnings per share. Wall Street has been modeling TSMC to earn 56 cents per American depositary receipt, up 4% year over year.
Taiwan Semi's U.S. shares fell 3.3% to close at 44.57 on the stock market today , hitting a new record high.
On Wednesday, TSMC broke out of a seven-week cup-with-handle base with a buy point of 42.67. It ended the day up 2.1% to 43.13, above the entry point. Volume rose 33% above normal, slightly below the 40%-50% minimum you'd like to see on a breakout. Also, the relative strength line, which tracks a stock's performance vs. the S&P 500 index, remained well off recent highs.
Apple shares rose 0.1% to 179.26 after moving back into buy zone on so-so volume and a lagging RS line.
